column1: # flow_ref 1 source=tests/spec/flow_semantics/slow_tick_panics.onsa tests=6 evaluated=6 unavailable=0 skipped=0 waiting=0
@ the division of a tick does not panic between the ticks, whatever the 0 that is stored
@ the division of a tick panics at the tick that reads the 0, in the call that holds it
@ a call of 0 frames at the position of a tick does not evaluate the tick
@ a call of 5 frames that holds the tick 4 panics at it
render slow_tick_panics.inv sr=0x41000000 params p=0 frames=5
@ the same call does not panic with 4 frames: the tick 4 is not in it
render slow_tick_panics.inv sr=0x41000000 params p=0 frames=4
@ a value that is not 0 is divided at each tick
render slow_tick_panics.inv sr=0x41000000 params p=4 frames=8
